subject: Regarding Your Recent Job Application
body: Dear John, Thank you for submitting your application for the Marketing Coordinator position at ABC Company. We have received a high volume of applications and are currently in the process of reviewing each one carefully. We will contact you within the next two weeks to inform you of the next steps in the hiring process. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and look forward to potentially working with you. Best regards, Jane Doe, HR Manager
